title: VerifyCommand
responsibility: Registers the harness verify run and check commands.

inputs.name: registerVerifyCommand.program
inputs.description: The Commander program that receives the verify command and its run, plan, check, identity, stamp, and capture subcommands. Run can retain one declared generated file with a passing full record. It must be a Command instance.

outputs.name: registerVerifyCommand
outputs.description: No value is returned; calling the function registers the verify command and its subcommands on the supplied Commander program.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: For verify check, the handler calls fail with the newline-joined report problems when the report status is failed and --json is absent.
